name: Leander
source:
“I can keep you safe as long as you trust me.”

Intent on using his magic for the good of Eridia, Leander founded the Bloodhounds to help those in need. Charming and outgoing, he believes in working hard and partying harder—even if that means occasionally overindulging on both.

Leander’s magic can’t cure you, but the sense of normalcy he offers is a luxury you’ve never experienced. He’s determined to save you and asks for nothing in return, but could he be too good to be true?

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/touchstarved/touchstarved?ref=f3kxoe]Kickstarter[/url]]
